title: Semiconductor Optoelectronic Devices for Fibre Optic Systems Applications, Part 2: Measuring Methods
clause_1_scope: This part of lEC 62007 describes tine measuring metlnods applicable to the semiconductor optoelectronic devices to be used in the field of fibre optic digital communication systems and subsystems. All optical fibres and cables that are defined in lEC 60793 series, lEC 60794 series are applicable. All optical connectors that are defined in lEC 60874 series are applicable, if a pigtail is to be terminated with an optical connector.
clause_3_terminology: Semiconductor Optoelectronic Devices for Fibre Optic Systems Applications

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
